item.title: Ecchitober: Day 23 - "Invocation"
item.media:title: Ecchitober: Day 23 - "Invocation"
item.media:description:
Yo! Lillith here!

(spinning slowly around in my office chair) Here is today's entry: "Invocation."

(Pausing for a moment to pull out my phone, striking a dramatic, theatrical pose as I read from the screen) Ah, apparently the Boss was going on and on about how masterfully he "threaded" the previous prompts together, linking an earlier theme directly to the portal from Day 20 just to bring us this piece, or something along those lines.

(Moving my feet while lazily scrolling through my messages) look, the poor guy is clearly starting to hallucinate from exhaustion by this point. But I am not going to question it (nor his eco-friendly asset-recycling habits inherited straight from FromSoftware) because honestly? I am reaching that exact same level of sleep-deprived delirium myself.

As for the lore behind today's image? It is pretty much what you see: the summoners successfully called upon Beato. Or wait... was it Beato who forced her way through the portal to confront the summoners? Who knows. At this point, I just want to finish filing this report and go to sleep early.

Tomorrow's theme is "Crypt."

What did you think of today's invocation theme and our summoned guest, or do you have any suggestions for the upcoming days? Let me know in the comments.

Stay sharp.

—Lillith Murasaki (HR Manager)

item.title: Ecchitober: Day 22 - "Coffin"
item.media:title: Ecchitober: Day 22 - "Coffin"
item.media:description:
Yo! Lillith here! Look, even if the goal is to simulate digital inking, the Boss really shouldn't abuse pure black quite this much. When I pointed that out, he started rambling on about negative space, composition theory, and goodness knows what else. But deep down, we both knew he just wanted to rush and go to sleep early, and honestly? Fair enough.

Moving on with today's report: the concept for today is "Coffin", and the victim (never has that word been more accurate for this prompt) is Luna Blanc. The owner of the Woodheart Café was somehow convinced to pull off a "bloody countess" act for the Harvest Night festivities. The only minor issue with vampires in this universe is that they tend to be completely inactive during daylight hours, especially when expected to just lie around inside a confined space doing absolutely nothing. Just look at her sleeping so peacefully...

Anyway, tomorrow's theme is "Invocation". (A loud, heavy yawn escapes me) Maybe I should just follow Luna's example and fall asleep right here at my desk.

What did you think of today's coffin theme and our sleeping vampire countess, or do you have any suggestions for the upcoming days? Let me know in the comments.

Stay sharp.

—Lillith Murasaki (HR Manager)

item.title: Ecchitober: Day 21 - "Eternal Night"
item.media:title: Ecchitober: Day 21 - "Eternal Night"
item.media:description:
Yo! Lillith here!

(adjusting my glasses at my desk) Today, the Boss decided to get a bit more "poetic" with the theme, though time constraints might have worked against him when trying to fully portray what he had in mind. Still, hopefully the core message gets across.

To capture the essence of the eternal night, we have Elenora making another appearance. Apparently, whenever she shows up in these drawings, it awakens the Boss's deep, sentimental side because he graces us with another one of his poems:

The station of last things

Mortals delight in carelessness so light,

thinking there will always be a final chance to love,

to laugh, or bid a friend goodbye,

blind to the very truth they face tonight.

How joyful to live so long, I'd say with irony,

if I hadn't buried everyone I watched depart;

I've had eternities to learn the pain of a broken heart,

and winters still remain to weep their absence silently.

Think it over well: today might end a company,

for there are partings we fail to name in time;

always assuming another chance will start to climb,

while watching the train depart that you waited for eternally.

Sometimes, I really feel like giving the Boss's characters a proper hug, they clearly need it. As for me? Who knows, maybe I just need a higher salary or a long vacation instead.

Tomorrow's theme is "Coffin", and with that said,and a piece of cake, see you all at eight!

What did you think of today's eternal night theme and poem, or do you have any suggestions for the upcoming days? Let me know in the comments.

Stay sharp.

—Lillith Murasaki (HR Manager)
